definitions.ask: Should a reader parked at the real bottom of a tall newest Reply block still auto-land on newly arrived turns?
definitions.why: Keeps today's new-turn landing at the bottom; only the per-refresh yank to the header goes

choices.label: Lands on each newly arrived turn, but stays put on in-place refreshes (chat-log behavior)
Never moves; new turns only announce through block-rail arrival dots
